item.title: An integrated human forebrain organoid reveals microglia-mediated CD8+ T cell recruitment and neuroimmune dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease pathology.
item.description:
Must read · eLife · section: Human iPSC Neural Models · topic is in the title · model: human iPSC-derived microglia, brain organoids / assembloids · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Human iPSC Neural Models definition: strong · published this week
Using this platform, we demonstrate that microglia mediate amyloid-β clearance and neuronal maturation but also drive inflammatory activation and recruit CD8+ T cells through CCL4/5 signaling via CCR1/5 and CXCR3, establishing a neuroinflammatory feedback loop.

item.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screen reveals that Wnt signaling regulates lipid accumulation in APOE4 oligodendrocytes.
item.description:
Worth reading · Cell stem cell · section: Human iPSC Neural Models · central targets: APOE · model: brain organoids / assembloids, transgenic mouse · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Human iPSC Neural Models definition: moderate
Using a genome-wide CRISPR screen and assay for transposase-accessible chromatin (ATAC) sequencing in human-induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived oligodendrocytes, we identified decreased Wnt signaling and overactive glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (GSK3B) as key regulators of lipid-droplet accumulation.
